summary: Frontend-only foundations testing for Baobab Cargo PWA. All navigation, responsive layout (360/768/1280), light/dark theme toggle, empty states, and 404 route verified. Only minor accessibility warnings and one missing empty-state testid found.

ui_bugs.issue: Expected data-testid 'client-profile-empty' is missing. The page renders profile fields (data-testid profile-field-*) instead of an empty state. Parcels and Shipments empty states exist correctly.

issues: Radix DialogContent used by Sheet is missing DialogTitle and Description — console errors/warnings: '`DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle` for the component to be accessible'. Wrap the title with VisuallyHidden or add a hidden SheetTitle/SheetDescription in AdminLayout mobile drawer.

action_items: Add data-testid='client-profile-empty' (or a small empty state) to /client/profile if a pedagogical empty state is intended, OR update spec since the page shows profile fields.

Fix a11y warnings on Admin mobile Sheet: add <SheetTitle> (can wrap with VisuallyHidden) and <SheetDescription> inside SheetContent in src/components/layout/AdminLayout.jsx to remove Radix DialogContent a11y console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLayout mobile Sheet triggers Radix a11y console errors on every open — add SheetTitle/Description.

PWA install banner (data-testid pwa-install-banner/install-pwa-btn) not rendered in preview (expected — beforeinstallprompt does not fire in iframe; manifest link is present in <head> and service-worker.js exists). Verified installable-ready.
Manifest is correctly linked (https://.../manifest.json) and no page-level JS errors detected.
test_credentials: None — no auth in this phase.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Foundations verified: Landing CTAs -> /client and /admin work, theme-toggle-btn toggles .dark class on <html>, client sidebar shows on desktop and bottom nav on 360px mobile, admin desktop sidebar and mobile hamburger Sheet drawer both work with all 5 nav items, empty states present for client-parcels-empty/client-shipments-empty, 404 route shows notfound-home-btn, no horizontal overflow at 768px, no PWA banner in preview iframe (expected). Only issues: missing client-profile-empty testid on profile page, and Radix a11y warnings on the admin mobile Sheet.
